attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of earnings conference call held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE on November 20, 2026. The call, held on November 13, 2026, discussed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was INR452 crores, up 19.9% year-on-year. EBITDA was INR50 crores with an 11.1% margin. Profit after tax was INR15.9 crores. For H1 FY27, revenue was INR856.9 crores, up 18.4%. EBITDA was INR106.6 crores. PAT was INR39.3 crores. The company added 41 company-owned stores in Q2, bringing the total to 205 stores across 137 cities. It also reported 2,589 MBOs across 787 cities. Management noted positive October trends despite festive sales shifting to Q3. Raw material costs remain elevated due to geopolitical disruptions.

voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE regarding the publication of a newspaper advertisement. The advertisement was published on November 14, 2026, in the Financial Express and Hosadigantha newspapers. It pertains to the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The information is also available on the company website.
